sections.title: What Do You Get as a Host Partner?

features.title: Full Screen Inside Ad
features.description: Your ad plays at 100% full screen, with no other material on screen while it runs. You worked hard to get customers in the door, so use that time to inform, educate, and promote your products and services with a custom full-motion video ad. It's a perfect vehicle for higher-margin, lesser-known items.

features.title: Ads at Other Host Locations
features.description: Your outside ad plays on nearby non-competing host screens across our network, reaching current and potential new customers where they work, shop, eat, and play, and keeping your business top of mind.

features.title: Vertical Ads
features.description: Verticals are images that play on the right side of the screen and are mostly reserved for the host partner. When your full-screen ad isn't playing, your verticals keep your promos front and center to boost point-of-sale purchases.

features.title: Content Creation
features.description: We handle the creative for our host partners. Just provide a few design elements, like pictures and messages, and we'll take it from there.

features.title: Access to Marketing Services
features.description: Host partners also get access to our full range of marketing services, from websites and social media to pay-per-click advertising and geofencing.

features.title: Local Support
features.description: We're a local {city} business. Whether it's a technical question, an ad change, or a new campaign idea, we're here to meet with you and take care of it.

sections.title: How Do I Become a Host Partner?
sections.description: Hosting an indoor digital billboard is easy! We take care of everything from the installation to the ad creation. It's as easy as 1-2-3.

cards.title: Step 1: Contact Us
cards.description: Reach out to our team to let us know you're interested in hosting a screen. We'll talk about your location, your customers, and how the network can benefit your business.

cards.title: Step 2: Setup a Free Consultation
cards.description: We'll visit your business, find the best spot for your screen, and walk you through how your ads play inside your location and across our screen advertising network.

cards.title: Step 3: Approve Your Ad and Installation Date
cards.description: Review and approve your custom venue ad design, then select a convenient installation date. Our professional team will handle all technical setup, and you'll be live on the network in no time.

sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.description: Everything you need to know about hosting an indoor digital billboard at your venue.

faqs.question: What does my venue need to host an indoor digital billboard?
faqs.answer: Not much! Our team handles everything from assessing the best screen placement to the full technical installation. We'll visit your venue during a free consultation to find the ideal spot, and our professional team takes care of all the setup.

faqs.question: What do venue partners receive in return for hosting a screen?
faqs.answer: Host partners get a full-screen ad and vertical ads that play to customers inside their own business, plus their ads shown at nearby non-competing host locations across the network. You also get access to our full range of marketing services, from website design to social media management.

faqs.question: Who creates the ad content for my venue?
faqs.answer: We do! We handle the creative for our host partners. Just provide a few design elements, like pictures and messages, and our team will take it from there.

faqs.question: Can I use the screen to promote my own business inside my venue?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. That's one of the biggest benefits. Your full-screen ad and verticals promote your specials, new items, and services to the customers already in your business, while your ads also run across the rest of the network.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: It's as easy as 1-2-3: reach out to our team, schedule a free on-site consultation, then approve your ad design and installation date. You'll be live on the network in no time.
